proved_step: SIMULATION THEOREM (EGC-001 B): a deterministic escalating graph transducer with configuration size S_graph and k_t events per input (each event O(1) records of O(log S_graph) bits, deterministic scheduler, termination) is simulated by a one-pass streaming machine with space O(S_graph) and update time O(k_t) RAM / O(k_t S_graph) TM / per-step circuits O(k_t S_graph log S_graph); conversely every streaming transducer is a one-node graph. Hence Lemma M is invariant under escalating graphs. Spec theory/oracle-elimination/EGC-001-SIMULATION.md.
